skill.name: tiktok-ad-library-creative-center-ads-examples-top-ads
skill.description: Use PipiAds to find TikTok ad examples and review their opening hooks, offers, advertisers, and promoted products.
skill.summary: Find TikTok ad examples and compare creative patterns with PipiAds.
skill.author: pipiads-dev

security_audit.summary: The backticks mark Markdown labels, and no evidence of shell backtick execution or credential exfiltration was found. Setup passes an API key to the configured MCP server and directs users to a separate, unverified domain for billing. The global package install and per-result search charges also warrant explicit user approval.

remediation.issue: The MCP process receives the PipiAds API key.
remediation.suggestion: Require approval before enabling the connector, use a dedicated key with limited permissions where available, and keep the key out of chat and logs.

remediation.issue: Setup declares a global npm installation.
remediation.suggestion: Use an isolated, user-approved install and verify the package publisher and integrity before executing the connector.

remediation.issue: Credential and billing setup uses a different domain from the listed homepage.
remediation.suggestion: Link to onboarding from the verified provider homepage and document who operates the separate billing domain before directing users there.

remediation.issue: Search results and detail requests can consume account credits.
remediation.suggestion: Set a small default result limit and obtain approval for a credit budget before broad or repeated requests.

content.value_statement: Finding relevant TikTok ad examples is difficult when you need to compare specific markets or product categories. Use PipiAds to narrow your search and summarize opening hooks, visual styles, and offers.
actual_capabilities: Search PipiAds for TikTok ads by keyword, region, and time range.
Inspect selected ad records and summarize opening hooks, visual styles, creator-led formats, and offers.
Find promoted products and review linked landing page details when available.
Search for advertisers and inspect their profiles.
Find stores linked to ad activity and inspect their profiles.
limitations: Requires a configured PipiAds MCP connector and a PipiAds API key.
Search results and some detail requests consume PipiAds credits.
Uses PipiAds data rather than querying TikTok Creative Center directly.
Does not cover Facebook ad research or standalone TikTok Shop analytics.

use_cases.title: Plan a set of creative tests
use_cases.description: Compare opening hooks and visual formats from recent ads in one market. Use those observations to propose original concepts to test.

use_cases.title: Review product offers across ads
use_cases.description: Find ads for a product category and inspect available landing page details. Compare how sellers describe the product and present the offer.

use_cases.title: Track competitor creative patterns
use_cases.description: Review selected ad examples and advertiser profiles to identify repeated messages, offers, and formats.

prompt_templates.title: Find recent ad examples
prompt_templates.prompt: Find up to five TikTok ads about running shoes in Canada from the past 30 days. List the advertiser and the opening hook when available.

prompt_templates.title: Compare opening hooks
prompt_templates.scenario: Review creative details from a short list.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find up to six TikTok ads for travel backpacks in the United States from the past 30 days. Inspect three and compare their hooks, visuals, and offers.

prompt_templates.title: Compare ads with product pages
prompt_templates.scenario: Check whether landing pages support the ad message.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find four TikTok ads for compact blenders in Australia from the past 60 days. Review two linked product pages and flag any differences in the advertised offer.

prompt_templates.title: Compare creative patterns across markets
prompt_templates.scenario: Run a scoped competitor study with a credit limit.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare TikTok ads for pet grooming tools in Canada and the United States over the past 60 days. Propose a credit budget before searching and wait for approval. Group observations by advertiser and separate creative patterns from performance claims.

output_examples.input: Compare the hooks and offers in three recent Canadian running shoe ads.
output: Ad A opens with a wet pavement traction demo and offers free shipping.
Ad B shows a runner switching shoes before a commute and offers a first-order discount.
Ad C opens with a close-up of the sole. No offer was visible in the reviewed ad detail.

output_examples.input: Check whether two travel backpack ads match their linked product offers.
output: Ad A promises a free packing cube. The linked product page lists it as a separate purchase.
Ad B shows a detachable pouch. The linked page confirms that it comes with the bag.

best_practices: Specify a product category, region, and date range before searching.
Set a result limit and credit budget before requesting large searches or detail lookups.
Verify the provider's onboarding and billing links, and configure the API key locally instead of sharing it in chat.
anti_patterns: Assuming a high-engagement ad proves sales, profitability, or results for your own campaign.
Requesting every matching ad or detail record without setting a credit limit.
Using this skill for Facebook monitoring or TikTok Shop analytics without ad research.

faq.question: Does this connect directly to TikTok Creative Center?
faq.answer: No. It researches TikTok ads through the PipiAds MCP connector.

faq.question: What do I need to run it?
faq.answer: You need a configured PipiAds MCP connector and a PipiAds API key. Set the key locally rather than sharing it in chat.

faq.question: Do searches use credits?
faq.answer: The documented rate is one credit per search result. A detail request costs one credit unless the same record was queried within the previous three days.

faq.question: Can I filter ads by market and date?
faq.answer: Yes. Specify the region, date range, and product or keyword to narrow the search.

faq.question: Can I inspect the products or sellers behind an ad?
faq.answer: Yes. The connector can look up products, advertisers, and stores. Linked landing page details depend on the available product records.

faq.question: Can this tell me which ads were profitable?
faq.answer: No. Use the examples to compare creative patterns. Engagement or appearance in search results does not establish profitability.
